segments.name: Interactive Entertainment
segments.description: Develops, publishes and markets interactive entertainment content for console, mobile and PC players worldwide through its publishing labels.
segments.evidence: We develop, operate, and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga.

revenueModel.text: Players and consumers pay for interactive entertainment content, including software titles, in-game virtual items, add-on content, live services and advertising.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive substantially all of our revenue from the sale of our interactive entertainment content, which includes internally developed software titles and software titles developed by third parties, in-game virtual items and advertising, and live services on console, mobile, and PC.
